sn21.12:1.2: Atha kho dve bhikkhū sahāyakā āyasmato MahāKappinassa saddhivihārikā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || || 3
sn21.12:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā te bhikkhū dūrato va āgacchante || || 4
sn21.12:1.5: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave ete dve bhikkhū sahāyake āgacchante Kappinassa saddhivihārino ti || ||
sn21.12:1.7: Ete kho te bhikkhū mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā || ||
sn21.12:1.8: Na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tehi bhikkhūhi asamāpannapubbā || ||
sn21.12:1.9: Yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchi katvā upasampajja viharanti || || 6
sn21.12:2.2: Idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
sn21.12:6.6: samattaṃ || || [Dasabalaselappabbhavā nibbānamahāsamuddapariyantā atthaṅgamasalilā jinavacananadī ciraṃ vahatū ti --]
